name: Remote Activity Monitor
description: Live CPU cores, memory, network, disk, per-card GPUs and processes of a remote Linux machine over SSH, in Orca's sidebar. A fork of Activity Monitor for paired servers and SSH boxes.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Remote Activity Monitor: memory on the remote host is critical

settings.title: SSH host
settings.description: Host to monitor, as you would type it after `ssh`: an alias from ~/.ssh/config or user@hostname. Key-based login is required; the host needs Linux and python3.
